title: X-PostHog-Trace-Id is codex-only, and the fallback trace id must come from the stamped header
answers: can I set X-PostHog-Trace-Id for claude runs
where should the turn trace id for a rating be resolved
why not infer trace id from runtime_adapter in forward_pending_message
body:
Invariant 1: Never send `X-PostHog-Trace-Id` on Claude gateway headers. The gateway ranks this header above `traceparent`, so Claude's per-turn trace ids would collapse into one id for the whole run. Enforced in agent-server.ts:configureEnvironment (`taskRunId && runtimeAdapter === "codex"`) and tested in agent-server.configure-environment.test.ts ("names the run as X-PostHog-Trace-Id for codex only").
Invariant 2: `AgentServer.stampedRunTraceId` is read straight from `gatewayEnv.openaiCustomHeaders["X-PostHog-Trace-Id"]`. It is never inferred from `runtime_adapter`, and it is reset unconditionally on every init so a re-init does not keep a stale run's id. A Codex run with no `AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN` falls back to the Python gateway and gets no stamp. Inferring the id would point a rating at a trace with no generations.
Convention: Resolve the turn trace id in the agent-server, next to the stamp. Do not resolve it in the Temporal activity `forward_pending_message` under products/tasks/. That activity never sees the direct relay or the turn-complete event paths, and three reviewers rejected that approach.
applies: Any change to gateway headers or turn trace id resolution in products/desktop/packages/agent/src/server/agent-server.ts
